successors.name: United Arab Republic
successors.text: the Gaza Strip, 'the All-Palestine Protectorate, which came to be called the Gaza Strip'

ledger.x: 22 September 1948: Egypt declares the All-Palestine Protectorate at Gaza.
22 September 1948: the government is placed under Egyptian protection.
June 1959: Nasser annuls the All-Palestine Government.

wars.name: 1948 Arab-Israeli War (Gaza front)
wars.outcome: The armistice of 24 February 1949 left Egypt the Gaza Strip, 'under official Egyptian protection' as the All-Palestine Protectorate.

certainty.note: The Egyptian front ran through the Gaza area until the armistice.
The armistice line of 24 February 1949 'fixed the boundaries of the Gaza Strip'.
